verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms llms.txt is live (HTTP 200) at posthog.com/llms.txt with structured agent-readable content, and PostHog also documents .md variants of docs pages (e.g., product-analytics.md, session-replay.md) explicitly served for machine/agent consumption alongside a documented MCP server for agent interaction.
